Register of Deeds Office
Register of Deeds Office
The Register of Deeds Office handles the recording of many documents pertaining to land transactions such as all types of deeds, mortgages, land contracts, liens and more. The Register is a member of the Plat Board for the County.
Original documents are required for recording and go through an indexing process before they are returned to the customer, usually within a week of the recording date.
We are certified passport agents and take passport photos. See our passport link for more information.
While we pride ourselves in providing friendly assistance to anyone who has a need for our services, we unfortunately cannot aid in the completion of documents or offer any advice that may be considered legal advice. We do not provide blank deeds for completion. Those can be found online, at a local office supply store, or you may seek the advice of an attorney or title company that specializes in the preparation of deeds.
The County of Alpena Register of Deeds office accepts e-recordings from 8 am until 3:30 p.m. daily, and paper/walk-in recordings until 4:00 p.m. daily. If you submit via e-recording or bring a document in after these times, they will be put on the next day's business.
The County of Alpena Register of Deeds office offers Laredo and Tapestry for your document searching and printing needs. If you are in need of a one-time copy or two, Tapestry is best for this service. If you are a title company or regular searcher, you may wish to use Laredo. Please view the links in the menu to the left.
We also offer free property fraud alert and free notary fraud alert . Both services are for Alpena County only and will notify you via phone, text, and/or email if a document is recorded with your name on it.
For more information on our services, please visit the links in the menu to the left.
